title: Bank & ATM Explorer: Banking Basics
learningGoals: Understand the safety benefits of a bank
Identify the steps to open a bank account
Understand how banks help money grow over time

teachingScript.teacherLine: A bank is like a fortress for your money. Instead of keeping cash under your pillow, you keep it in a secure place called a Bank Account.

data.title: Why Use a Bank?
points: Safety: Vaults and security protect your cash.
Record Keeping: A Passbook tracks every Paise.
Growth: Banks give you extra money (Interest) for saving.

teachingScript.teacherLine: Let's look at your Bank Portal. Here you can see your balance and transactions.

questionPool.questionText: What is the document that tracks your bank transactions called?
questionPool.hint: It's a book that shows where your money goes. Also available as a digital statement.
